axes: D=XY normal; Y=scan Z; X=XY tangent
tangent_normal: exact saved T6 local frames, no cross-Z fitting
sampling: scipy trilinear order1 float32, round half-even to uint8; no additional anti-alias filter
prediction: official sigmoid/interpolate; mean of four central output pixels at even-grid center
sensitivity: 32 evenly spaced valid centers on each ofZ128,152,177; normal reversal and depth offsets -2,+2; no selection or replacement of primary result
limitations: straight tangent-plane approximation over1.22mm; no longitudinal tilt estimation; native center registration not calibrated; no proof centers lie on ink-bearing surface
